description: This is a Java class named ProductFileManagerImpl that manages product images within an e-commerce system. It handles uploading, resizing, cropping, retrieving, and removing product images, interacting with content and image utilities, configuration settings, and external image storage components.

classes.name: ProductFileManagerImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of product image management, handling upload, resize, crop, retrieval, and removal of product images with support for configuration-based image processing.

methods.name: addProductImage
methods.description: Uploads a product image, processes resizing and cropping based on configuration, and handles multiple image sizes.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves the specified product image as an output content file.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Retrieves a list of images for a merchant store or product.

methods.name: removeProductImages
methods.description: Removes all images associated with a product.

methods.name: removeImages
methods.description: Removes images associated with a merchant store.
